events.verdict: Gasol (MEM) maintains legal guarding position as marginal contact is made with Jokic (DEN) during his drive toward the basket.
Gasol (MEM) slightly follows through with his arm to Jokic's (DEN) body, but the contact is marginal during his shot attempt.
Green (MEM) sets the pick on Murray (DEN), who is stationary, and gives him room to avoid the contact.
Murray (DEN) places his hand to Green's (MEM) opposite side hip as the pick is set and makes contact that is tactile in nature.
Jokic (DEN) initiates contact with his left forearm to Green's (MEM) body, affecting his ability to rebound.
Temple (MEM) places his hand to Jokic's (DEN) midsection and makes contact that is tactile in nature.
Temple (MEM) extends a hand to Murray's (DEN) back as he is mid-air during his shot attempt.
Murray (DEN) makes marginal contact with Conley (MEM) at the end of the drive that does not affect his ability to complete the play.

Green (MEM) briefly engages with Plumlee (DEN) as the shot is released, but disengages without affecting his ability to retrieve the rebound.
Temple (MEM) commits the take foul on Murray (DEN) in the back-court.
Murray (DEN) engages and disengages with Temple (MEM) during the inbound without affecting his FOM.
Temple (MEM) commits the take foul on Murray (DEN).
Plumlee (DEN) makes marginal contact with Green's (MEM) front during his upward shooting motion.
Anderson (MEM) and Murray (DEN) engage and disengage during the inbound without affecting the other's FOM.

Temple (MEM) commits the take foul on Hernangomez (DEN) in the lane.
Gasol (MEM) does not give Craig's (DEN) room to avoid the contact.
Temple (MEM) cleanly tips the ball away Plumlee (DEN) along the baseline.
